field_principles.exact_match_validated: BARE bool=true -- every synthesized grid scored by EXACT ARC grid match (the fabrication guard); a synthesis claim without exact-match validation is void.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A ceiling-break, a selection-matches-synthesis, and a no-gain are ALL COMPLETE and decision-grade.
field_principles.model_specs: The per-cell reconciliation (+ optional bounded GGUF AggLM arm) + controls; required methodology.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition; the held-out split + bootstrap reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the pool + ranked families + synthesized grids; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.synthesis_beats_selection: BARE bool: synthesis@1 > selector-only@1 with CI95-excl-0 -- does reconciliation add value over picking the best cached candidate.
field_principles.synthesis_breaks_oracle_ceiling: BARE bool: synthesis@1 > oracle@K with CI95-excl-0 -- the headline: synthesis solved tasks where NO candidate was correct (Compute-as-Teacher thesis).
field_principles.synthesis_minus_oracle_delta: synthesis@1 - oracle@K -- the ceiling-break magnitude; positive is the un-fakeable evidence synthesis exceeds selection.
field_principles.synthesis_minus_vote_delta: synthesis@1 - vote@1 -- the total lift over majority vote.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- synthesis is guided by the learned set-encoder scores, no demo execution; keeps it oracle-distinct.

controls.no_synthesis_baseline_at_1: same best single cached candidate by score; reported separately to make the no-generation control explicit
controls.oracle_at_k: any cached candidate exact-matches reconstructed gold/induced target hash
controls.selector_only_at_1: highest Exp 4244 out-of-fold set-encoder score candidate

exact_match_validation.grid_hash: canonical JSON SHA-256 over ARC grid
exact_match_validation.missing_target_policy: score false by exact target-hash set; never infer correctness from fuzzy similarity

headline_method.cell_policy: sum learned set-encoder scores per color per cell; deterministic low-color tie break
headline_method.name: score_weighted_per_cell_reconciliation

optional_agglm_reconciler.reason: not invoked in this run; deterministic per-cell reconciliation is the headline arm

upstream_set_encoder_model_specs.architecture_note: Permutation-equivariant DeepSets scorer: per-candidate MLP embedding, mean/max pooled full-set context, and per-candidate logits conditioned on that context.
upstream_set_encoder_model_specs.cross_candidate_conditioning: vote priors, self-consistency margins, modal-grid agreement, duplicate counts, shape/palette family indicators, and DeepSets mean/max latent pooling over all candidates
upstream_set_encoder_model_specs.imbalance_loss: class_weighted_bce_with_positive_task_minibatches; negative-only tasks are scored held-out but do not form training minibatches
upstream_set_encoder_model_specs.set_attention_reference: CPU-fast fallback for the Set-LLM set-attention-mask / Set-Encoder cross-candidate attention lever; still consumes the full candidate set without positional features.
